newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-National Foods sees slight profit rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-National Foods sees slight profit rise.

text.p: National Foods Ltd Chairman Barry Capp said on Thursday the company is still budgeting for a slight improvement in net profit for the year to June 30, 1997.
"We are still budgeting for a slight improvement this year," Capp told reporters, after the beverage and dairy group's annual profits, when asked about net profit for the current year.
Capp said that market conditions were fairly tight and the company was operating in a flat market.
"We are operating in a flat and difficult trading environement and I don't see it getting better over the next financial year," Capp said.
"Frankly I can't see any economic pick-up until the end of next year," he said
Managing director Max Ould said the company was operating in a mature market and any profit gain would mainly come from cost reductions and operating efficiencies.
National Foods reported a net profit of A$15.05 million in 1995/96.
Earlier the beverage and diary group said first quarter sales and earnings before tax were marginally a head of last year. Capp said he could give no figures for the quarter.
National Foods shares rose four cents to A$1.55.
